# David Packer Reports Greasing The Groove With EMOM Sessions For Front Lever Progress In His Own Training

David Packer reports that greasing the groove worked very well for his front lever progress, and he used it five times per week with small EMOM sessions spaced throughout the day. [src: vid-lkcLJc2c0NQ]

## Details

- Greasing the groove is good for simple movements like front lever, front lever pull-ups, regular pull-ups or handstand push-ups. [src: vid-lkcLJc2c0NQ]
- He did it five times a week, mixing small EMOM sessions along with greasing the groove. [src: vid-lkcLJc2c0NQ]
- He would maybe do like a five or ten sets of five or ten minute EMOM, three times spaced out. [src: vid-lkcLJc2c0NQ]
- The sessions were very small and very light. [src: vid-lkcLJc2c0NQ]

## Evidence

- vid-lkcLJc2c0NQ (David Packer): "it for very simple movements like front lever front lever pull-ups regular pull-ups or handstand push-ups it can be good"
- vid-lkcLJc2c0NQ (David Packer): "my experience with this exercise has been it has been a lot easier for me to be able to do this exercise with it was very very good with front lever"
- vid-lkcLJc2c0NQ (David Packer): "this time it was five times a week i mixed oh emom was the new thing as well so i had small emom sessions along with um greasing the groove so maybe i'll do like a five or ten sets of um you know five ten minute emom and i might do that three times spaced out"
